description: Generates the code of a new table from a spec or from a built-in spec: the files, the setup of the project, once per project, and what is left to finish by hand. The fillings are the templates of the cells, the rules of the custom filters and the bodies of the functions of the skin config (get_docs, topic fillings); without them the files keep TODOs. A spec with errors returns the report of validate_spec and no files. For one cell, the row details or the filters of an existing table use scaffold_component. Example: {"builtinSpec": "products", "target": "angular", "skin": "mat"}

builtinSpec.description: The name of a built-in spec instead of a spec: orders, Orders with custom cells and their actions, row details, filters in the Filter Drawer, buttons of the toolbar, a message of a state and a taller row; users-server, Users loaded from the server page by page, with a search of the toolbar and the sort of the columns; products, The smallest table: columns of the fields of a row, the rows loaded by the page

fillings.description: The parts of the code that you write: the templates of the cells, the rules of the custom filters and the bodies of the functions of the skin config; get_docs, topic fillings

callbacks.description: The bodies of the functions of the skin config, by the skin and the path, as components.sortHeader.afterRender

imports.description: Angular: the components of the project that the template uses; the classes of Angular Material and the pipes of Angular come from the template

from.description: The path of the module, as ./order-badge

anyOf.description: The name of a class of Angular Material or of a pipe of Angular, as DatePipe

members.description: The members of the class: computed values, handlers

render.description: Vanilla JS: the body of render(), which builds the DOM of the cell

styles.description: Angular: the styles of the component

template.description: Angular: the template of the component, in every skin
